title: Explicit userId clears are ignored in session state
reasoning: The update API accepts userId?: string | null, and the sync payload parser preserves an explicit null userId. However update computes nextUserId with userId || currentUserId and only assigns when nextUserId is truthy, so a caller cannot clear the stored userId. A session switch or logout-style sync that sends userId: null will keep using the prior userId, which can attach later transcript operations to the wrong user.
recommendation: Treat undefined as 'leave unchanged' and null as 'clear'. For example, compute nextUserId with userId === undefined ? currentUserId : userId and assign currentUserId directly.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests are included for session sync null semantics or clearing a previously loaded userId.
suggestedRegressionTest: Create a transcript session state with an initial stored userId, call update(undefined, null), and assert get().userId is null while conversationRef remains unchanged.
minimumFixScope: Update createTranscriptSessionState.update and add focused session state tests for undefined versus null.
